module_rows.title: Population Genetics, GWAS & PRS Studio
module_rows.summary: Cohort QC, ancestry structure, association screening, regional review and polygenic-risk exploration in one reproducible workflow.
module_rows.purpose: Use genotype, phenotype and covariate data to identify quality problems, population structure and association candidates before specialist mixed-model validation.
module_rows.boundary: Exploratory screening does not replace validated PLINK, SAIGE or REGENIE pipelines, imputation, ancestry-matched validation or clinical interpretation.
last_mile_features: Fixed-effect meta-analysis when beta/SE/study are supplied

benchmark_profile.name: Population Gwas Peak benchmark
benchmark_profile.boundary: Benchmark results measure the supplied truth pack only and are not a substitute for independent external validation.

module_rows.title: Epigenomics & Chromatin Accessibility Workbench
module_rows.summary: ATAC-seq, ChIP-seq, CUT&RUN, methylation and regulatory-region analysis with RNA integration and provenance.
module_rows.purpose: Prioritise differential regulatory regions, transcription-factor activity and peak-to-gene links while preserving genome build and assay context.
module_rows.boundary: Screening-level region analysis must be confirmed with replicate-aware specialist pipelines, matched genome builds and orthogonal assays.

benchmark_profile.name: Epigenomics Peak benchmark
benchmark_profile.boundary: Benchmark results measure the supplied truth pack only and are not a substitute for independent external validation.

module_rows.title: Pharmacogenomics & Clinical Genomics Studio
module_rows.summary: Variant-to-haplotype, phenotype and drug-gene evidence review with explicit confidence and research-use boundaries.
module_rows.purpose: Connect pharmacogene variants, diplotypes and medication evidence without presenting exploratory calls as clinical recommendations.
module_rows.boundary: Research-use output is not a prescribing recommendation. Clinical decisions require validated genotyping, current guidelines and qualified professional review.

benchmark_profile.name: Pharmacogenomics Peak benchmark
benchmark_profile.boundary: Benchmark results measure the supplied truth pack only and are not a substitute for independent external validation.

module_rows.title: Structural Variant, Repeat Expansion & Mosaicism Studio
module_rows.summary: Harmonise deletions, duplications, inversions, translocations, repeat expansions, mobile-element insertions and mosaic candidates.
module_rows.purpose: Combine caller support, size, allele fraction, gene disruption and inheritance evidence into an auditable review queue.
module_rows.boundary: Breakpoints and mosaic fractions require raw-read review and orthogonal confirmation; this module does not manufacture clinical classifications.

benchmark_profile.name: Structural Variant Peak benchmark
benchmark_profile.boundary: Benchmark results measure the supplied truth pack only and are not a substitute for independent external validation.

module_rows.title: RNA Splicing & Isoform Pathology Lab
module_rows.summary: Detect exon usage, intron retention, splice-site shifts, isoform switching and transcript-level pathology signals.
module_rows.purpose: Bridge transcriptomics, long-read evidence and variant interpretation through junction-aware, uncertainty-labelled analysis.
module_rows.boundary: Built-in calculations are exploratory and do not replace splice-aware alignment, transcript assembly or validated DEXSeq, DRIMSeq, MAJIQ or long-read workflows.

benchmark_profile.name: Rna Splicing Peak benchmark
benchmark_profile.boundary: Benchmark results measure the supplied truth pack only and are not a substitute for independent external validation.

module_rows.title: Immunogenomics & Immune Repertoire Studio
module_rows.summary: HLA, TCR and BCR repertoire analytics with clonotype expansion, diversity, V(D)J usage and longitudinal tracking.
module_rows.purpose: Inspect repertoire composition and immune clone dynamics while separating technical sampling effects from biological interpretation.
module_rows.boundary: Repertoire frequencies are sensitive to library preparation, sampling depth and clonotype definition; biological conclusions require matched experimental design.

benchmark_profile.name: Immune Repertoire benchmark
benchmark_profile.boundary: Benchmark results measure the supplied truth pack only and are not a substitute for independent external validation.

module_rows.title: Single-Cell Multiome & Regulatory Network Studio
module_rows.summary: Joint scRNA, scATAC and protein-tag analysis with modality QC, integrated embeddings and regulatory links.
module_rows.purpose: Build a transparent multi-modal cell-state view with marker agreement, batch diagnostics, peak-to-gene links and TF activity.
module_rows.boundary: Joint embeddings and transferred labels are exploratory. Validate modality integration, cell labels and regulatory links with independent evidence.

benchmark_profile.name: Single Cell Multiome benchmark
benchmark_profile.boundary: Benchmark results measure the supplied truth pack only and are not a substitute for independent external validation.

module_rows.title: Proteogenomics & Neoantigen Discovery Studio
module_rows.summary: Connect genomic variants, RNA expression, peptide evidence, HLA binding and normal-tissue risk for neoantigen research.
module_rows.purpose: Rank candidate variant peptides using multiple evidence layers and retain every exclusion and uncertainty decision.
module_rows.boundary: Predicted binding and immunogenicity do not establish therapeutic efficacy. Candidates require validated HLA typing, assays and safety review.

benchmark_profile.name: Proteogenomics Peak benchmark
benchmark_profile.boundary: Benchmark results measure the supplied truth pack only and are not a substitute for independent external validation.

module_rows.title: Gene Regulatory Network & TF Activity Studio
module_rows.summary: Infer evidence-weighted TF-target relationships, regulon activity and condition-specific master regulators.
module_rows.purpose: Combine expression, accessibility and motif evidence into reviewable regulatory hypotheses rather than opaque network claims.
module_rows.boundary: Inferred regulatory edges are hypotheses and must be validated with perturbation, binding or orthogonal evidence.

benchmark_profile.name: Gene Regulatory Network benchmark
benchmark_profile.boundary: Benchmark results measure the supplied truth pack only and are not a substitute for independent external validation.

module_rows.title: Federated Genomic Discovery & Phenopacket Studio
module_rows.summary: Phenopacket, pedigree and Beacon-style cohort discovery with consent-aware source provenance.
module_rows.purpose: Match phenotype and variant evidence across local or federated sources without hiding access restrictions or match uncertainty.
module_rows.boundary: Federated discovery does not grant access to restricted records and must respect consent, governance and source-specific interpretation rules.

benchmark_profile.name: Federated Genomic Discovery benchmark
benchmark_profile.boundary: Benchmark results measure the supplied truth pack only and are not a substitute for independent external validation.

module_rows.title: Viral Genomics & Within-Host Evolution Studio
module_rows.summary: Consensus, minor-variant, lineage, recombination, selection and longitudinal within-host evolution analysis.
module_rows.purpose: Separate low-frequency noise from reproducible viral evolution signals and connect sequence changes to time and lineage context.
module_rows.boundary: Low-frequency variants are highly sensitive to sequencing and contamination artefacts; confirm with validated callers, controls and replicate evidence.

benchmark_profile.name: Viral Within Host benchmark
benchmark_profile.boundary: Benchmark results measure the supplied truth pack only and are not a substitute for independent external validation.

module_rows.title: Genome Annotation & Comparative Annotation Studio
module_rows.summary: Validate GFF/GTF gene models, compare annotation versions and integrate orthology, protein-domain and synteny evidence.
module_rows.purpose: Create an auditable annotation review queue that separates model completeness from functional evidence.
module_rows.boundary: Automated annotation transfer can propagate errors. Curated gene models and experimental evidence remain authoritative.

benchmark_profile.name: Genome Annotation benchmark
benchmark_profile.boundary: Benchmark results measure the supplied truth pack only and are not a substitute for independent external validation.

module_rows.title: Circular DNA, Mobile Elements & Genome Instability Studio
module_rows.summary: Review ecDNA, circular DNA, mobile-element insertions, amplification structures and complex rearrangement candidates.
module_rows.purpose: Integrate breakpoint, copy-number and read-support evidence into a transparent genome-instability review workflow.
module_rows.boundary: Complex rearrangement structures require raw-read, assembly and orthogonal validation; inferred circles are research hypotheses.

benchmark_profile.name: Circular Dna Instability benchmark
benchmark_profile.boundary: Benchmark results measure the supplied truth pack only and are not a substitute for independent external validation.

module_rows.title: Environmental Genomics & eDNA Surveillance Studio
module_rows.summary: Species detection, occupancy, biodiversity, contamination-control and spatiotemporal eDNA surveillance.
module_rows.purpose: Distinguish biological detections from background contamination and reference-library uncertainty across sites and sampling events.
module_rows.boundary: eDNA detection depends on sampling design, assay specificity, reference coverage and environmental persistence; presence does not prove abundance or viability.

benchmark_profile.name: Environmental Edna benchmark
benchmark_profile.boundary: Benchmark results measure the supplied truth pack only and are not a substitute for independent external validation.

module_rows.title: Comparative Regulatory Genomics Studio
module_rows.summary: Compare conserved non-coding regions, enhancer activity, motif turnover and regulatory synteny across species.
module_rows.purpose: Connect sequence conservation and functional activity without treating conservation alone as proof of regulatory function.
module_rows.boundary: Conservation and motif presence are indirect evidence. Functional claims require species- and tissue-matched experimental validation.

benchmark_profile.name: Comparative Regulatory Genomics benchmark
benchmark_profile.boundary: Benchmark results measure the supplied truth pack only and are not a substitute for independent external validation.
